scope: The project is understood to be electrical work and has been reviewed and quoted as such.
All work to be completed during normal business hours, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
Installation per plan. All changes will require a written Change Order approved by the Owner before work proceeds.
Based on the electrical specifications, schedules, and drawing set dated 07.15.2026. Sheets: E0.1, E1.0, E1.1, E2.0, E2.1, E3.0.
Coordinate with Sample General Contractor for scheduling, tie-ins, and required access.
Submit for and obtain all required electrical permits prior to commencement of work.

sections.title: A. Service & Distribution
bullets: Accurate Power & Technology will furnish and install the complete 800A, 120/208V, 3-phase, 4-wire service entrance assembly and MDP (ECFECI), fed by the utility pad-mount transformer secondary.

bullets.t: panels A, B, C, K, L and S, with feeders and disconnects throughout.

bullets: Surge protective device, lighting contactors, time clock and photocell control at the main distribution section (ECFECI).
Complete grounding and bonding system per NEC Article 250, including ground rods, water main bond and structural steel bond.

sections.title: B. Branch Power
bullets: Branch raceway, conductors and devices throughout - receptacles, GFCI receptacles, floor boxes, and equipment connections per the device and equipment power schedules.
HVAC and refrigeration disconnects, roof-top unit connections, and door hardware power as shown.

sections.title: C. Lighting & Controls

bullets.t: - procured through the Southern Lighting Source national account (770-242-4000). EC to receive, inventory, and install all fixtures per schedule.

bullets: Controls & testing: occupancy sensors, photocells, lighting contactors and dimming controls as shown; functional testing prior to final inspection.
Fixture types per schedule: A, AE, B1, B1E, B2, C, CE, F, FE, G, GE, LP, P1, P2, X2, R1.

sections.title: D. Site Lighting, Underground Work & Allowances
bullets: Site and pole lighting per the photometric plan, including fixtures, poles and pole wiring.
Underground conduit to be Schedule 40 PVC with a minimum 24" cover; all above-grade conduit to be rigid galvanized steel through the 6" transition elbow.
160' allowance - service feeder from the utility transformer secondary to the main distribution panel.
225' allowance - incoming network / telecommunications conduit from the property line to the IT rack.

sections.title: E. Low Voltage Infrastructure (Conduit & Boxes Only)
bullets: Conduit, junction boxes and pull strings for security, tele/data and sound/intercom systems - cabling, devices and programming by Owner's vendor.
Fire alarm sprinkler monitoring conduit and boxes per the FA sheets.

sections.title: F. Project Coordination & Closeout
bullets: Coordination with the General Contractor, other trades and the serving utility; arc-flash labeling, firestopping, conductor color coding, junction box labeling and typed panel directories.
As-built drawings, O&M manuals, one-year warranty on labor and materials, and all required inspections and testing.

exclusions: Tele/data, security and sound system cabling, devices and programming by others. EC provides conduit and boxes only.
Utility company transformer, primary-side work and utility fees are excluded. EC provides 8' of conductor slack at the transformer secondary.
Concrete pole bases, trenching backfill compaction testing, painting, patching and finish restoration are excluded.
This proposal is based on the equipment quantities, ratings and configuration shown in the package dated 07.15.26. Revisions to quantities, ratings or locations will be addressed by Change Order.
Temporary power beyond a single temporary service pole is excluded.
Items not shown on the electrical drawings at the time of bid are excluded.

items.description: Type AE - 2x4 LED troffer w/ emergency battery pack
Type J1 - LED area light, 20' mounting height
17' square steel pole on 3' concrete base (base by others)
Ceiling-mount occupancy sensor w/ power pack
Service feeder allowance - transformer secondary to MDP
3/4" EMT + 4-11/16" box w/ pull string, data outlet
5/8" x 10' copper-clad ground rod w/ exothermic connection

terms: Based on electrical drawings and SOW dated 07.15.2026. All work per NEC 2020, FBC 2023, and FFPC 2021.
Price valid for 30 days from date of proposal. Material costs subject to market fluctuation at time of order.
A deposit of 25% of the contract value is required upon execution of this agreement to initiate material procurement.
Lighting package to be procured through the Southern Lighting Source national account. EC to receive, inventory, and install.
Equipment lead times subject to market and manufacturer availability. APT not responsible for vendor delays.
All changes to the approved scope require a written Change Order signed by the Owner prior to proceeding.
Painting, patching, concrete cutting, and finish restoration are excluded from this scope.
Low-voltage cabling, devices, and programming (security, tele/data, sound/intercom) by Owner's vendor. EC provides conduit and boxes only.
Utility company transformer, primary-side work, and utility fees excluded. EC provides 8' conductor slack at transformer secondary.
All work performed under valid permits in compliance with local, state, and AHJ requirements.
